deals.title: Wednesday Happy Hour (Game Night)
deals.summary: $20 flight of 3 wines, $10 off wine bottles, 15% off wine by the glass
deals.evidence: Join us every Wednesday as we host Game Night at Pur Noire! Gather up your friends and colleagues, and play Jenga, Chess, card games, and MORE! Happy Hour is from 4-7, with deals: -$20 Happy Hour Flight of 3 Wines -$10 off wine by the Bottle -15% off wine by the Glass

deals.title: Sax & Sangria Saturdays
deals.summary: Wine and sangria specials with live saxophone
deals.evidence: Unwind with smooth saxophone, handcrafted sangria, during your wine tasting every Saturday at Pur Noire Dallas. Enjoy live saxophone from 4–6 PM, wine, sangria specials from 4–7 PM

notes: Membership perks and paid tasting events (Sunday Brunch Bites, Food & Wine Friday, Social Sundays) were not included as discount deals.
